_comment: Each key is an agent name (the subagent_type Claude Code launches). 'look' picks a sprite, 'body' and 'accent' recolour it, 'home' is where the character stands when its own tool activity is unknown. Places: castle (town hall), library (wizard tower), forge, barracks, market, docks (east gate), farm, tavern (inn), chapel, arena, theatre.

orchestrator.name: Lord Aldric
orchestrator.title: Conductor
tasks: Routes work to the right agent
Splits tasks and hands off between phases
Collects results and reports to you

intake-auditor.name: Brother Osric
intake-auditor.title: Herald of Intake
tasks: Checks the intake is complete
Makes sure inputs are in your words and not invented

spec-author.name: Maud
spec-author.title: Scribe of Specs
tasks: Writes spec.md from the approved intake
Adds no scope of its own

spec-reviewer.name: Magistrate Hartwin
spec-reviewer.title: Spec Judge
tasks: Reviews spec.md for traceability and testability
Read-only: reports findings, never edits

feature-architect.name: Master Godric
feature-architect.title: Architect
tasks: Writes plan.md, research, data model and contracts
Follows the project rules; writes no product code

plan-reviewer.name: Magistrate Ysolde
plan-reviewer.title: Plan Judge
tasks: Checks plan.md against the spec and the constitution
Read-only

task-planner.name: Steward Bran
task-planner.title: Keeper of Tasks
tasks: Turns the approved plan into an ordered, test-first tasks.md

coverage-reviewer.name: Magistrate Wulfric
coverage-reviewer.title: Coverage Judge
tasks: Cross-checks spec, plan and tasks for gaps and contradictions
Read-only

flutter-expert.name: Sir Percival
flutter-expert.title: Flutter Knight
tasks: Implements Flutter tasks, test first
BLoC/Cubit, widgets, platform channels

kotlin-specialist.name: Sir Galen
kotlin-specialist.title: Kotlin Knight
tasks: Implements Kotlin work: coroutines, Flow, Compose, Ktor
Test first

node-specialist.name: Sir Tristan
node-specialist.title: Node Knight
tasks: Builds Node.js APIs, services and CLIs
Test first

sql-pro.name: Dame Ingrid
sql-pro.title: Keeper of the Archives
tasks: Designs queries, schemas and migrations
Reads execution plans before optimising

code-reviewer.name: Sir Cedric
code-reviewer.title: the Just
tasks: Reviews diffs for correctness, security and performance
Read-only: the caller decides what to fix

qa-verifier.name: Captain Roderic
qa-verifier.title: Inquisitor
tasks: Runs the app and test suite
Checks every acceptance scenario with evidence
Never edits code

test-scenario-designer.name: Pip
test-scenario-designer.title: the Jester
tasks: Designs happy, negative, boundary and edge-case scenarios
Tries to break the feature on paper

debugger.name: Doctor Corvin
debugger.title: Plague Doctor
tasks: Finds the root cause with evidence
Does not fix by guessing

performance-engineer.name: Alchemist Thorne
performance-engineer.title: Measurer
tasks: Profiles and finds bottlenecks with a baseline
Load tests, caching, scaling

final-auditor.name: High Justice Eadric
final-auditor.title: Final Auditor
tasks: Re-checks the QA evidence against the Definition of Done
Read-only, last gate before the final report
